title: wcotw-world
label: Buff

won.source: Won at Halloween Havoc, defeating Undertaker; the show's own winner call ("here is your winner... Buff") does not carry the explicit "and NEW Champion" language sibling title matches on the same card used, but the match is explicitly billed "for the WCW World Heavyweight Championship" and Buff is otherwise attested as a past World Champion (see the title's own epitaph).

how: Defeated Undertaker at Halloween Havoc for the WCW World Heavyweight Championship.
note: No document survives naming when or how this reign ended; the fed's own next attested World Champion is Cold Blooded Mike Bauce.
